rationale: itnet_v2-claude-agentic: itnet_k=1, unet_c=32, itnet_alpha_init=0.0001, residual_learning=False, pretrain_lr=0.00025, pretrain_epochs=15, pretrain_patience=15, grad_clip=1.0, train_n=2400, val_n=200, seed=42, rationale=ITER-15 (v3 sentinel, normal QOS, strict serial). SIX-BOX (sentinel-verified): alpha trend MONOTONIC-better as it shrinks: alpha0.0026 hr0.8768(i6), alpha0.001 0.8804(i13), alpha0.0004 0.8853(i14)=BEST (+0.0049). The k=1 DC step is best VERY WEAK (approaching pure pretrained denoiser). (2) OPEN QUESTION: does hr keep rising toward alpha->0? Test one more step down. (3) ONE KNOB vs iter-14 (c32/n2400/alpha0.0004): itnet_alpha_init 0.0004 -> 0.0001. Hold c=32, n=2400, k=1, lr=2.5e-4, ep=15, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42. (4) HYPOTHESIS: if alpha 0.0004->0.0001, hr rises above 0.8853 because an even weaker DC step corrupts the strong denoiser recon even less (the learned alpha is softplus(log_alpha) so alpha_init sets the starting DC strength). FALSIFIER: hr <= ~0.885 (flat/down) => alpha optimum reached ~0.0004; iter-16 LOCKS the best-alpha champion and begins seed replicates for mean+/-std. (5) BUDGET: identical to iter-6 (c32/n2400) -- only alpha changes. (6) STRICT one-at-a-time; rm DONE.* first; confirm via ssh cat DONE.<jobid>.
